Kit summary

Resonant TweedleBasic
Attacks a single enemy, dealing [HP Burning] DMG by 14% of Erato's Max HP and inflicting 1 layer of [HP Burning] for 2 turns.
Burst NotesActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 5 stages of DMG to enemies, each of which deals [HP Burning] DMG by 5.2% of Erato's Max HP to a random single enemy. If Burst Notes hits the same target twice or more than twice during a single cast, inflicts [Severe Wound] on the target for 2 turns. When any enemy's HP is under 30% for the first time in each wave, Erato cleanses all control effects from self and casts Burst Notes to pursue and attack the enemy once. If an ally's HP loss reaches 20% because of taking an enemy's single stage of DMG, Erato will cast Burst Notes to counterattack once. This effect can only be triggered once for every 2 turns.
Iridescent Keyboard Lv.3Burst Notes: Each stage additionally deals 1 stage of DMG by 35% of the original and the extra stages of DMG will be increased to 100% of the original to Bosses. The extra DMG ignores [Shield], [Immortal], and [DMG Immunity] on enemies (excluding Boss). The following effects will be triggered when casting Party Sonata: 1. If there are fewer than 5 enemies on the battlefield, for every 1 absent enemy, reduces CD of Party Sonata by 1 turn. 2. If [Rich Harmony] owned by Erato is stacked to 20 layers, casts Burst Notes immediately to pursue and attack enemies who have not triggered the pursue-and-attack effect of Burst Notes. 3. Resets all enemies' chances to trigger the pursue-and-attack effect of Burst Notes.
Synchronous BeatsPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Invalidates counterattacks and pursue-and-attacks that use basic attacks and regard Erato as the main target. Erato inflicts 1 layer of [Magic Sound] on the enemy who meets any one of the requirements below: 1. Loses every 25% of Max HP. 2. Under [HP Burning] status and becomes the main target of allies' basic attacks and active skills. Each layer of [Magic Sound] reduces Mastery RES by 14%, up to 6 layers can be owned. When Erato inflicts [Magic Sound] on targets with 6 layers of [Magic Sound], this skill effect will be changed into: grants self 1 layer of [Rich Harmony]. Each layer of [Rich Harmony] increases DMG dealt by Burst Notes by 2.5%, up to 50 layers can be owned.
Iridescent Keyboard Lv.1Enhances Synchronous Beats: When an enemy becomes the main target of allies' basic attacks/active skills/pursue-and-attacks, Erato will inflict 1 layer of [Magic Sound] on them. Meanwhile, the cap of [Rich Harmony] is increased to 100 layers.
Iridescent Keyboard Lv.2Increases all allies' Max HP by 15%. At the beginning of each wave, grants all allies [Melodious Tweedle], lasting for 2 of Erato's turns. In the duration of [Melodious Tweedle], each stage of DMG taken by the owner cannot exceed 25% of the owner's Max HP. When the duration of [Melodious Tweedle] ends, reduces all enemies' Max HP by 15%. Additionally, invalidates counterattacks and pursue-and-attacks that use basic attacks and regard an ally of Erato as the main target. This effect can only be triggered twice and the chances to trigger it will be reset at the beginning of Erato's turns.
Party SonataActiveExclusive Lv.3
Grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns, and deals 5 stages of DMG to all enemies, each of which deals DMG by 2.8% of Erato's Max HP and is considered as [HP Burning] DMG. Afterward, inflicts 1 layer of [HP Burning] on all enemies for 2 turns.
Iridescent Keyboard Lv.3Burst Notes: Each stage additionally deals 1 stage of DMG by 35% of the original and the extra stages of DMG will be increased to 100% of the original to Bosses. The extra DMG ignores [Shield], [Immortal], and [DMG Immunity] on enemies (excluding Boss). The following effects will be triggered when casting Party Sonata: 1. If there are fewer than 5 enemies on the battlefield, for every 1 absent enemy, reduces CD of Party Sonata by 1 turn. 2. If [Rich Harmony] owned by Erato is stacked to 20 layers, casts Burst Notes immediately to pursue and attack enemies who have not triggered the pursue-and-attack effect of Burst Notes. 3. Resets all enemies' chances to trigger the pursue-and-attack effect of Burst Notes.
